c74object.name: zerr.features~
c74object.digest: Extract audio features from a signal as audio-rate control signals
c74object.description: Use the zerr.features~ object to extract audio features (loudness, brightness, zero crossings, spectral change and more) from a mono signal. Each argument names one feature and adds one signal outlet; the outlets are the control signals that drive zerr.envelopes~. With no argument the object extracts rms.

inlet.description: The signal whose features are extracted. Also accepts bang.

outlet.digest: Feature signals, one outlet per argument
outlet.description: One signal outlet per feature argument, in argument order. Each carries that feature's value, updated at audio rate.

objarg.name: feature
objarg.description: Each argument names one feature to extract and adds one outlet. Valid names: rms (root mean square, loudness), zcr (zero-crossing rate), flx (spectral flux, change), cf (crest factor), ctd (spectral centroid, brightness), rlf (spectral rolloff), flt (spectral flatness), zc (zero crossings, a pulse at each crossing). Default: rms.

method.name: bang
method.description: Posts the package version, the extracted features in outlet order, the signal vector size and the sample rate to the Max Console. Useful to confirm which build of the object is loaded.

c74object.discussion: Feature ranges differ: rms, flt and zcr stay within 0 to 1, ctd and rlf are in Hz, cf is a ratio at or above 1, and zc is a pulse train. Scale a feature into the 0 to 1 range expected by the control inlet of zerr.envelopes~ with ordinary signal arithmetic (*~, -~, clip~); the package's examples folder shows this for four features. The analysis window is 2048 samples; the signal vector size must not exceed it. The features are not normalised: they are control signals, never audio. Do not connect an outlet to dac~; scale it and send it to zerr.envelopes~. All features except zc are measured over the last 2048 samples and updated once per signal vector, ramped linearly across it, so they are smooth and lag by about 46 ms at 44.1 kHz. zc is sample-accurate and touches 1 exactly on every zero crossing, which makes it a ready trigger for a trigger-mode zerr.envelopes~; set interval there, or the sound jumps hundreds of times a second. Level leaks into rms and flx only; the other features are ratios or frequencies.

entry.name: signal
entry.description: One feature value per outlet, as a signal.
